WITH s AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE (f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2,3)) AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) returns_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
  WHERE st.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period, s.sales_net, r.returns_net, s.sales_net - coalesce(r.returns_net,0) AS net_sales
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period) ORDER BY 2
